info.title: Tippr API
info.description: Football prediction league API. Authenticate with Supabase JWT token.

post.summary:
Sync tournament baseline data (teams, venues, fixtures) from API-FOOTBALL.
This is the initial sync that maps external data to existing teams/matches.
Use createMissingTeams=true to auto-create teams that don't exist in the database.

Sync tournament match results from API-FOOTBALL.
Updates scores and statuses for matches that are live or recently finished.

Sync match lineups from API-FOOTBALL.
Lineups are typically available ~60 minutes before kickoff.

get.summary:
Validate that a league/season combination exists in API-FOOTBALL
and check what data coverage is available.

post.summary:
Merge duplicate teams in a tournament.
Finds old teams (without ApiFootballId) and merges them with new teams (with ApiFootballId).
Transfers DisplayName (Swedish name), FifaRank, FifaPoints, and updates all references.
Use dryRun=true (default) to preview changes without applying them.

Sync group standings from API-FOOTBALL.
Creates groups if they don't exist, assigns teams to groups,
and updates group standings (position, points, goals, etc.).

Sync team squads (players) from API-FOOTBALL.
Fetches all players for all teams in the tournament.
Players are used for top scorer predictions and lineup display.

get.summary: Retrieves the current authenticated user's profile information.
get.description: Auth: JWT Bearer token required Side Effects: Updates the user's LastLoginAt timestamp Example Request: ``` GET /api/auth/me Authorization: Bearer ``` Example Response: ``` { "isSuccess": true, "data": { "userId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "email": "user@example.com", "username": "johndoe", "displayName": "John Doe", "avatarUrl": "https://storage.example.com/avatars/user.jpg", "bio": "Football enthusiast", "favoriteTeamId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "favoriteTeamName": "Manchester United", "lastLoginAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z", "role": "User" }, "error": null } ```

401.description: JWT token is missing or invalid

404.description: User has not been synced (should not occur with middleware)

post.summary: Submits a prediction for a bonus question within a league.
post.description: Auth: JWT Bearer token required Rules: User must be a member of the specified league BonusQuestion must belong to the league's tournament Cannot submit after the bonus question is resolved Submitting again will update the existing prediction Example Request (Team answer): ``` POST /api/bonus-predictions Authorization: Bearer Content-Type: application/json { "leagueId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "bonusQuestionId": "4fb96f75-6818-5673-c4gd-3d074g77bfb7", "answerTeamId": "5gc07h86-7929-6784-d5he-4e185h88cgc8", "answerText": null } ``` Example Request (Text answer): ``` POST /api/bonus-predictions Authorization: Bearer Content-Type: application/json { "leagueId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "bonusQuestionId": "4fb96f75-6818-5673-c4gd-3d074g77bfb7", "answerTeamId": null, "answerText": "Kylian Mbappe" } ``` Example Response: ``` { "isSuccess": true, "data": "6hd18i97-8030-7895-e6if-5f296i99dhd9", "error": null } ```

400.description: Question already resolved or invalid answer type

401.description: JWT token is missing or invalid

403.description: User is not a member of the league

404.description: League or bonus question not found

get.summary: Retrieves chat messages for a league with cursor-based pagination.
get.description: Auth: JWT Bearer token required Pagination: Uses cursor-based pagination for efficient scrolling through message history Example Request (first page): ``` GET /api/chat/messages?leagueId=3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6&take=50 Authorization: Bearer ``` Example Request (next page): ``` GET /api/chat/messages?leagueId=3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6&cursor=2024-01-15T10:30:00Z&take=50 Authorization: Bearer ``` Example Response: ``` { "isSuccess": true, "data": { "messages": [ { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "displayName": "John Doe", "avatarUrl": "https://...", "content": "Great prediction on the Brazil game!", "createdAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z" }, { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "displayName": "Jane Smith", "avatarUrl": "https://...", "content": "Thanks! I had a feeling about that one.", "createdAt": "2024-01-15T10:28:00Z" } ], "nextCursor": "2024-01-15T10:25:00Z", "hasMore": true }, "error": null } ```

parameters.name: leagueId
parameters.description: The league ID to get messages for

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Optional cursor (CreatedAt timestamp) to fetch messages before this point

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Number of messages to retrieve (default: 50, max: 100)

delete.summary: Deletes a league and all associated data (Owner only).
delete.description: Auth: JWT Bearer token required (must be league owner) Warning: This is a destructive operation and cannot be undone Side Effects: Deletes the league, all memberships, predictions, standings, and chat messages Example Request: ``` DELETE /api/leagues/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 Authorization: Bearer ``` Example Response: ``` { "isSuccess": true, "data": true, "error": null } ```

parameters.description: The league ID to delete

post.summary: Joins an existing league using an optional invite code.
post.description: Auth: JWT Bearer token required Rules: Public leagues: No invite code required Private leagues: Valid invite code is required Cannot join if already a member Cannot join if league is at max capacity Side Effects: Creates a LeagueMember entry for the user Example Request: ``` POST /api/leagues/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/join Authorization: Bearer Content-Type: application/json { "inviteCode": "ABC123" } ``` Example Response: ``` { "isSuccess": true, "data": true, "error": null } ```

parameters.description: The league ID to join

post.summary: Leaves a league the current user is a member of.
post.description: Auth: JWT Bearer token required Rules: League owner cannot leave (must delete or transfer ownership) User must be a member to leave Side Effects: Removes LeagueMember entry User's predictions and standings remain for historical purposes Example Request: ``` POST /api/leagues/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/leave Authorization: Bearer ``` Example Response: ``` { "isSuccess": true, "data": true, "error": null } ```

put.summary: Updates the settings for a league (Owner only).
put.description: Auth: JWT Bearer token required (must be league owner) Partial Update: All fields are optional; only provided values are updated Settings: predictionMode: "BeforeKickoff" or "BeforeMatchday" deadlineMinutes: Minutes before kickoff when predictions lock pointsCorrectScore: Points for exact score prediction (default: 3) pointsCorrectOutcome: Points for correct outcome only (default: 1) pointsCorrectGoals: Points for correct total goals Bonus points for bracket predictions (round of 16, quarters, etc.) Example Request: ``` PUT /api/leagues/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/settings Authorization: Bearer Content-Type: application/json { "predictionMode": "BeforeKickoff", "deadlineMinutes": 15, "pointsCorrectScore": 3, "pointsCorrectOutcome": 1, "allowLateEdits": false } ``` Example Response: ``` { "isSuccess": true, "data": { "predictionMode": "BeforeKickoff", "deadlineMinutes": 15, "pointsCorrectScore": 3, "pointsCorrectOutcome": 1, "pointsCorrectGoals": 0, "allowLateEdits": false }, "error": null } ```

patch.summary: Updates the current user's profile information.
patch.description: Auth: JWT Bearer token required Partial Update: Only provided fields are updated; null/omitted fields are ignored Field Constraints: displayName: max 100 characters bio: max 500 characters (send empty string to clear) favoriteTeamId: must reference an existing team Example Request: ``` PATCH /api/users/profile Authorization: Bearer Content-Type: application/json { "displayName": "John Doe", "bio": "Football enthusiast since 1990", "favoriteTeamId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6" } ``` Example Response: ``` { "isSuccess": true, "data": { "id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "username": "johndoe", "displayName": "John Doe", "avatarUrl": "https://storage.example.com/avatars/user.jpg", "bio": "Football enthusiast since 1990", "favoriteTeamId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "favoriteTeamName": "Manchester United", "createdAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "updatedAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z" }, "error": null } ```
